description: This file implements encryption functionalities for the Notesnook project, including input transformation, encryption, and stream creation using the Sodium cryptography library.

classes.name: Encryption
classes.description: A class providing static methods for encrypting data and creating encryption streams.

methods.name: transformInput
methods.description: Converts input data into a Uint8Array based on its type and format.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input data using the Sodium library with optional output formatting.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a cryptographic stream for continuous data encryption.
